scope: Frozen E134 E119 stride3 best63; layer diagnostics only
readouts: Existing S0 before first geometry block, then actual S1..S12; S0 observed with a shared-head hook
loss: Unweighted common full public-priority-v1 in original raw-head domain; all leaf terms. Actual decoded geometry separately; do not alter training Loss.
geometry: Existing scoring.draft_geometry; details=True at S0/S3/S6/S9/S12, otherwise basic geometry/group/boundary metrics. Reuse identity-matched reference, S12 and final records from prior statistics.
primary_topology: Correct-and-unambiguous center axis order vs reference on a fixed reference K6 neighbor-pair union, excluding P-P pairs. Reference axis margin >=.10 pair local scale; predicted clear margin >=.02. Denominator fixed across layers.
neighbor_definition: KNN by center distance divided by mean sqrt(public pair areas); directed node-average recall; K=6 primary and K=4/8 sensitivity
separation_intent: Largest of four signed rectangle separation gaps; resolved if top gap minus runner-up >.02 pair local scale. Compatible if chosen direction is any reference permissible separation (gap>=-.01). Unresolved counts incorrect, not excluded.
stability: Agreement with S12 intent on reference K6 pairs resolved at S12; first layer after which all remaining layers stay above 90/95/99%. This is terminal structure formation, not proof of quality.
reference_good_definition: local axis accuracy and K6 recall both exceed the registered thresholds and remain so in all subsequent layers; not reached if S12 fails. Reference fidelity is not universal layout quality.
attention: Actual captured QKV and pair bias; normalized attention entropy, self/wire/group attention mass. No guessed attention map.
hidden: RMS, between-node participation-ratio effective dimension, block residual/input norm and state-embedding injection; raw input/encoded/global1/S0/S1..S12 hidden probes
linear_probe: Five-fold case-source-shard grouped cross-validation; only non-P nodes, per-case centered hidden and target reference centers/sqrt(total public area); equal case weights; standardize using train fold only; ridge lambda=.01*trace(Gram)/dimension, no tuning. Node-permuted training-label control at raw features/S0/S3/S6/S9/S12. Diagnostic statistical fit only, no new layout-model training.
gradient: Frozen eval-mode full-dev500 mean gradients of L3/L6/L9/L12, unweighted and registered-weighted; per-block norms and pairwise cosine on shared frontend/head/backbone1..3. No optimizer or parameter update; local diagnostic, not training history.
statistics: Equal case means; paired source-shard bootstrap 2000 replicates seed20261114; paired step deltas, 3-layer intervals, first attainment distributions. Tail=existing S12 final Q worst50, index tie-break. Correlations/AUC observational only.
